# `array_agg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_agg(expr)
```

Collects and returns a list of non-unique elements.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT array_agg(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (1) AS tab(col);
```

Result:

```text
[1,2,1]
```
